title: Time-varying optimal control under measurement errors
summary: Solving optimal control problems to determine a stabilizing controller involves a significant computational effort. Time-varying optimal control provides a remedy by designing a tracking system, given as an ordinary differential equation, to track the solution of the optimal control problem. To improve the applicability of the method, measurement errors are considered in this paper and it is described how these errors influence a control Lyapunov function-based decay condition.
